meta.describe: Binance spot crypto, slice_4h_40k bars, 2 symbols (LINK/USDT, LTC/USDT), 6,000 most recent in-sample rows. Label 2 ATR take-profit against 1 ATR stop within 12 bars. Split holds out the final 150 days with 12-bar embargo, 2 expanding folds. An elastic net at l1_ratio 0.7 screened at lambda.min, and the model fitted on the survivors. Models HistGBM, class weight balanced, rejecting above a 1.3 overfit ratio.
